Maya R: Quick async — crossflow microcheck: who is the owner for quantization recommendations for the billing-model rollout? Need: owner, target milestone (canary/date), and blockers. Prefer a single owner for the ship window. cc @Sam T @Andre K
Sam T: I can own the quant recs for billing-model v2. Planning to land PR by Thu. Blocker: model-quant PR awaiting perf bench. @Ryan L can you re-run the staging perf job?
Ryan L: On it. Re-running now; see logs:
```
./run_perf.sh --suite billing-staging --seed 42
... 2.3 tokens/ms, mem 8.2GB
```
Ryan L: found a regression vs main on 512 tokens — latency +18% p95. Tagging @Linda B for cache config check.
Linda B: I’ll investigate prefix caching. Quick note: if we bump batch size >8 we need to adjust KV cache flush / memory cap (cc @Andre K)
Andre K: I’ll take batching/caching recs end-to-end. Plan: produce config matrix by EOD tomorrow. Need someone to confirm SLOs for canary (latency p95 < 200ms).
Maya R: SLO is latency p95 <200ms, cost uplift <12% vs current. If config matrix shows tradeoffs, we’ll pick two candidates for canary. Also we need a migration plan for canary rollback.
Sam T: For regression alert — PR link: https://git.example.com/redwood/billing-quant/pulls/78. I added microbench results. Requesting quick CR from infra.
Andre K: noted. Assuming infra ok, I’ll add a canary rollout snippet to the deploy job:
```
- name: canary-deploy
  steps:
    - apply --target group=billing-canary
    - wait 10m
    - monitor perf p95
```
Ryan L: If perf still regresses after cache tweak, fall back to float16 quantization profile (less aggressive). I can run comparative evals.
Maya R: Cool — next steps: Sam owner for quant recs, Andre owner for batching/caching + canary config, Ryan runs perf re-runs & evals, Linda checks cache. We'll sync if any blocker. If someone can't hit EOD matrix, ping here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Build 4728 finished — staging image pushed (sha:abc123).
Sam T: grabbing the image now, will run PR benchmarks and report within 3 hours.
Maya R: Thanks team — appreciate the quick async. I'll create a tiny ownership doc in the project board.
